verdict.rationale: Phaser's first-party Phaser Editor ships a Scene Editor with an Inspector view, drag-and-drop object placement, scene layering and tilemap editing, so a visual level-building workflow exists. However, the core framework documents code-first scene construction in create(), and the editor is a separate licensed product rather than the primary workflow. Missing for 10: documented prefab support, evidence that the visual editor is the primary level-building path rather than an optional add-on, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the editor's viewport and composition depth.

support.subject: As a technical artist, a full visual editor — viewport, inspector, prefabs/scene composition — is the primary way to build levels

citations.quote: Drag and drop objects into place, tweak their animations, adjust their physics bodies, enable special effects and more as you go.
